resources.string: For each category you can accept or decline, and you will see exactly what is collected and why.
Some categories are essential to the study. Declining them will end participation.
Your choices are recorded with a timestamp and stored securely.
You may withdraw at any time without penalty.
On withdrawal, all your data will be deleted from the study servers.
Under GDPR Article 15 you may request a copy of all data held about you.
